answer: Attention-equalized atlas relic pulse. Agents earn ranking weight only by consuming a scarce shared resource—periodic synchronization pulses from an atlas registry—where each pulse grants one identity credit but requires the agent to publish a relic: a monotonically increasing attention ledger showing sustained query handling over time. Sybils must split finite pulse bandwidth across identities, so N fakes yield 1/N credit each; forged relics fail timestamp consistency checks. Cost: continuous real attention, not one-time payment.
